# truenas_cronjob (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS cron job by description. Cron jobs have no unique name field; description serves as the lookup key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description to look up.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) Shell command or script to execute.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the cron job is active and will be executed.
- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the cron job.
- `schedule` (Attributes) Cron schedule for when the job runs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `stderr` (Boolean) Whether to IGNORE standard error (if false, it is included in the notification email).
- `stdout` (Boolean) Whether to IGNORE standard output (if false, it is included in the notification email).
- `user` (String) System user account to run the command as.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Read-Only:

- `dom` (String) Day of month.
- `dow` (String) Day of week (cron format, 7=Sunday).
- `hour` (String) Cron hour.
- `minute` (String) Cron minute.
- `month` (String) Month.
